note: Short-answer reading questions for the Read and answer activity. Written for OpenPath on the existing passages (content/english/items/passages.json), not yet reviewed by an educator. Each key point lists groups of words or word stems (a stem ends in *); a key point is found when one entry of every group appears in the answer, allowing one wrong letter in longer words so that a spelling slip never hides understanding. 'contradicts' lists ideas that show a misreading. The rule-based evaluator (frontend/src/english/logic/reading.ts) marks understanding only from these, separately from spelling and grammar, and says it cannot tell when the answer matches neither. Judgements are provisional: not calibrated against marked answers from real children.

tasks.question: Why did Arjun give Meena his own kite?

key_points.text: Meena was sad or upset because she had lost her kite
Arjun wanted to cheer her up or be kind

contradicts.text: Arjun's kite was broken or he did not want it

tasks.model_answer: Meena was sad because her kite had flown away, so Arjun gave her his kite to cheer her up.

tasks.question: Why did Kiran take a deep breath instead of shouting at Dev?

key_points.text: She saw that Dev was sorry or upset (his tears, his face)
She chose to stay calm or be kind

contradicts.text: Kiran did not care about the volcano

tasks.model_answer: She saw that Dev was sorry and about to cry, so she calmed down instead of shouting.

tasks.question: Give one reason why a city can be hotter than the countryside.

key_points.text: One of: dark roads and roofs absorb heat; fewer trees or plants to cool the air; cars, air conditioners or factories make heat

contradicts.text: The sun is closer to cities, or cities get more sun

tasks.model_answer: Roads and roofs are made of dark materials that soak up the sun's heat.

tasks.question: Who chooses the bees' new home, and how?

key_points.text: The scout bees (not the queen) choose
They dance to show good sites, and the site with most support wins

tasks.model_answer: The scout bees choose. They do a waggle dance to show where good sites are, and the swarm goes to the site most scouts support.

tasks.question: What did Anand do when water started coming through the ceiling?

key_points.text: He put buckets under the leaks

contradicts.text: He hid under the table (that was two years earlier)

tasks.model_answer: He fetched two buckets and put them under the leaks.

tasks.question: How does plastic harm sea animals?

key_points.text: Animals eat it (mistaking bags for jellyfish, or birds feeding caps to chicks)
It fills their stomach so they stop eating and become weak

tasks.model_answer: Turtles and birds eat plastic by mistake. It fills their stomachs, so they stop eating and get weak.
